scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && if [ -z "$REDIS_URL" ]; then redis-server --daemonize yes --logfile /tmp/redis.log && until redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; do sleep 0.3; done && echo '[Redis] Local Redis ready'; else echo '[Redis] Using external REDIS_URL'; fi && pnpm run build && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
scripts.start: if [ -z "$REDIS_URL" ]; then redis-server --daemonize yes --logfile /tmp/redis.log && until redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; do sleep 0.3; done && echo '[Redis] Local Redis ready'; else echo '[Redis] Using external REDIS_URL'; fi && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
